question: What does the actual P0554 scalar parent plus bounded endpoint operator predict when the same composite equation, rather than the conservative route in isolation, is compared across galaxies, raw clusters, a route-formula transfer cluster, and the Solar System?

composite_equation.endpoint_source: Only the P0554 excess above baryonic GR is redistributed; the baryonic base stays local.
composite_equation.endpoint_constraint: The endpoint correction is curl-free and has zero circular monopole.
composite_equation.symmetry: The endpoint layer is exactly zero on the axisymmetric SPARC and point-source Solar controls, so those domains retain the P0554 scalar prediction.

claim_limits: This stage recombines already-computed predictions and does not create a new holdout.
The P0554 scalar formula and endpoint operator were selected in earlier project-spent stages.
The compact-halo comparator is limited to the historical validation subset and is not a full dark-matter posterior comparison.
Zero per-object gravity parameters does not mean zero nuisance parameters: ordinary galaxy and lens geometry nuisances remain.
The P0554 parent contains multiple universal constants selected from exploratory grids; it is not a one-parameter theory.
